question: At the frozen L1 bytes (ledger/citation_audit.csv sha256 315c19145065a5f9c95d64461eae760b4c296b06d1f2f09bc5847ac1a7064ce9), does the declared mirror_of graph agree with the identifier-keyed work graph, and what deterministic rule keyed on the resolved record (not on the identifier string) produces the canonical-merge map the L1 owner needs for dedup?
why_this_task: The worker-025 identity audit (artifact 5bd6b3263fea, claim w025-l1id-20260912T012600-claim) found 10 duplicate-identifier group entries across 9 connected components and stated that dedup must be keyed on the resolved record, not the identifier string. The immediate queue also carries the audit priority 'merge+dedupe the 14 ledger files'. No prior artifact reconciled the declared mirror_of graph with the identifier graph; SRC-020 (INSPIRE, no DOI, no arXiv) is reachable only through mirror_of, and SRC-093 declares mirror_of SRC-033 with a different title, year, DOI and arXiv id.

rule_under_test.R1_identifier_key: doi = lowercase, strip 'doi:', 'https://doi.org/', 'http://dx.doi.org/'; arxiv = lowercase, strip 'arxiv:', strip trailing 'vN'; a legacy arxiv id 'subj/NNNNNNN' also aliases its bare 'NNNNNNN' form for edge matching. key = 'doi:'+doi if doi else ('arxiv:'+arxiv if arxiv else None).
rule_under_test.R2_work_edge: rows i,j are in one work component if (a) they share a non-empty identifier key (or an arxiv alias), or (b) a declared mirror_of edge joins them and that edge is NOT suspect under R4.
rule_under_test.R3_component: union-find over R2; component id = lexicographically lowest citation_id in the component.
rule_under_test.R4_artifact_class_and_suspect: artifact_class from the record url only: PREPRINT if host arxiv.org/export.arxiv.org, PUBLISHED if host crossref.org, openalex.org, inspirehep.net with a literature/<digits> record path, or doi.org, else UNKNOWN. A declared mirror_of edge is SUSPECT (excluded from R2) when endpoint title agreement fails (normalized-title equality or token Jaccard < 0.90) or |year_i - year_j| > 4.
rule_under_test.R5_dispositions: MERGE_DUPLICATE when rows in one component share an artifact_class and title-agree: one canonical survives by precedence P1 record-locator resolved, P2 verification_method rank {primary-page-fetch:4, crossref-api:3, inspirehep-api:2, openalex:1, other:0}, P3 evidence_type rank {abstract:3, metadata:2, other:1}, P4 lowest citation_id; every merged row contributes the union of its used_by_theorems and class_mapping to the canonical proposal. LINK_ONLY when classes differ (PREPRINT vs PUBLISHED) and title agrees. MIRROR_ONLY_LINK when the component has no identifier edge at all. SUSPECT_MIRROR is reported and never merged.
rule_under_test.R6_no_write: the ledger is not written; the merge map is a proposal with unioned citation edges and superseded_by provenance, so no used_by_theorems edge is lost.

predictions.P1: the pin guard passes and the file has 97 rows, 0 duplicate citation_ids
predictions.P2: exactly 9 identifier-keyed components reproduce the 10 duplicate-identifier group entries of the 01:26 identity audit
predictions.P3: the declared mirror graph adds SRC-020 to the SRC-060/SRC-072 component (3 rows) and adds the mirror-only pairs {SRC-041,SRC-054} and {SRC-044,SRC-067}
predictions.P4: the SRC-093 -> SRC-033 mirror declaration is SUSPECT: different title, year, DOI and arXiv id
predictions.P5: three MERGE_DUPLICATE dispositions are proposed (components {SRC-020,SRC-060,SRC-072}, {SRC-059,SRC-071}, {SRC-044,SRC-067}) and 4 rows are superseded (SRC-020, SRC-044, SRC-071, SRC-072)
predictions.P6: at least one merge changes the citation-edge set: canonical SRC-060 gains D-002 from SRC-072; canonical SRC-059 keeps T-513/T-517/T-520; if the merge dropped edges, a used_by_theorems union would differ from the canonical row's own list
predictions.P7: the other seven components (SRC-021/056, SRC-033/088, SRC-023/055, SRC-002/068, SRC-066/089, SRC-057/086, SRC-024/087) are PREPRINT-vs-PUBLISHED pairs and are LINK_ONLY, not merges
predictions.P8: two consecutive runs produce byte-identical report.json with no network and no clock input

controls.C1: wrong expected pin -> exit 2 before any measurement
controls.C2: drop the mirror edges -> component count rises by exactly the 3 mirror-only components (12 -> 15 rows-components? measured, not asserted) and the 3 proposed MERGE_DUPLICATE groups disappear
controls.C3: rewrite SRC-072 title to a different work -> the component flips from MERGE_DUPLICATE to SUSPECT_MIRROR/title-conflict and no merge is proposed
controls.C4: reverse row order in the CSV -> canonical choice and dispositions unchanged (deterministic precedence, not input order)
controls.C5: swap used_by_theorems between SRC-060 and SRC-072 -> the unioned edge set is unchanged
controls.C6: the classifier never proposes a merge across PREPRINT/PUBLISHED classes
controls.C7: mutate the arxiv id of SRC-056 to a bare numeric alias of gr-qc/0307013 -> the SRC-021/056 component is unchanged

verdict_rule: MEASURED if the pin reproduces, all controls fire as pre-registered, and the report is byte-identical across two runs; otherwise the specific control that failed is reported and the deliverable is marked falsified.
falsifier: Re-run python3 run_l1_mirror_dedup_025.py --csv ledger/citation_audit.csv --expected-pin 315c19145065a5f9c95d64461eae760b4c296b06d1f2f09bc5847ac1a7064ce9 twice. Falsified if (a) the measured pin differs, (b) any pre-registered prediction P1-P8 fails without being reported as a failed prediction, (c) the two report.json files are not byte-identical, or (d) any disposition is not derivable from rules R1-R5 on the pinned bytes alone.
non_claims: not a mathematical or physics claim
not a gate verdict; G-LIT stays pending and only Astra/leads may move it
no ledger, map, rubric, detector or schema write; the merge map is an unfrozen proposal
